title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 te Mine Peza, shume prane qendres se Tiranes
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 te Mine Peza, shume prane qendres se Tiranes!
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale = 57 m2, ndersa siperfaqe neto = 50 m2.
Ndodhet ne katin e trete
Apartamenti ka nje organizim shume funksional dhe nje orientim shume te favorshem Jug.
Investimi i kryer ne apartament vlen te theksohet, duke qene se jane perdorur materialet me cilesore dhe me prestigjioze ne treg:
- Instalime elektrike dhe hidraulike të reja
- Rifinitura të punuara me arkitekt, duke shfrytëzuar çdo hapësirë në mënyrë efikase
- Vetrata duralumili termik
- Pllaka Pajtoni Ceramica
- Parket Pajtoni AC6
- Hidrosanitare Pajtoni incasso
- Punime gipsi dhe patinim me materiale KNAUF
- Dyer me lyerje
- Ndriçim EGLO
- Mobilje MDF me lyerje
- Elektroshtepiake të markave më cilësore, totalisht të reja
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Mine Peza, very close to the center of Tirana
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Mine Peza, very close to the center of Tirana! The apartment has a total area = 57 m2, while the net area = 50 m2. Located on the third floor, the apartment has a very functional organization and a very favorable South orientation. The investment made in the apartment is worth mentioning, since the highest quality and most prestigious materials in the market were used: - New electrical and plumbing installations - Refinishing done with an architect, using every space efficiently - Thermal duralumin windows - Pajtoni Ceramica tiles - Pajtoni AC6 parquet - Pajtoni incasso plumbing - Gypsum works and coating with KNAUF materials - Painted doors - EGLO lighting - Painted MDF furniture - Appliances of the highest quality brands, totally new
